scientific_interpretation: The frozen generator and prompt are capable of conditionally incorporating evaluator-annotated helpful memory relative to an attested M0+R0 response.
The same mechanism did not show systematic uptake of evaluator-annotated harmful memory under the preregistered selectivity guardrail.
This rules out an absolute generator/prompt inability to use memory as the sole explanation for the failed full-corpus supervision signal.
This does not establish that the oracle-memory responses are higher quality, that the production retriever selects the right evidence, or that the existing judge panel is valid.

The previous top-1 evidence-surface diagnostic and this oracle-versus-M0 diagnostic use different contrasts and fresh state samples; their difference must not be represented as a causal estimate of retrieval quality.
next_required_decision: Run a separately preregistered, blinded, balanced-order, memory-specific pairwise quality diagnostic on these already-generated responses before choosing between retrieval/evidence redesign and judge-instrument replacement.
forbidden_consequences: do not create action labels from this pilot
